A '''massage chair''' was a piece of furniture. [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] owned a massage chair that he thought was lucky.

==History==
The [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] commissioned a furniture maker in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] to construct a massage chair for him as Dug physiology made it difficult to find chairs that were comfortable for them.<ref name="VD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Sebulba also acquired the [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Twin/Legends|twin]] [[Yobana/Legends|masseuses]] [[Ann Gella/Legends|Ann]] and [[Tann Gella/Legends|Tann Gella]]. He came to consider the massage chair to be "lucky."<ref name="RPG-Core" />
